summary: Comprehensive testing of Smart Canteen Management System completed successfully. All backend APIs working correctly, frontend UI flows functional for all user roles (student, staff, admin). Authentication, menu browsing, cart management, time slot booking, staff order management, and admin analytics all working as expected.
passed_tests: Landing page loads with Get Started and Sign In buttons
User registration and login flows for all roles
Menu page displays food items with categories and filtering
Cart page shows items with quantity controls
Staff login and order management view
Staff time slot creation and management
Admin user management with role changes
Authentication redirects based on user roles
